title: orchestrate-triage-staggered-deps-upgrade-for-py-js-go-sdks-and-safe-api-sunset
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Large coordinated effort to bump and harmonize transitive and direct dependencies across Redwood language SDKs (Python, JavaScript, Go), remove legacy API surface ergonomics, and introduce a staged compatibility shim strategy to minimize customer breakage. Deliverables: versioned dep matrix, CI gating, per-language migration guides, canary rollout and automated rollback hooks, and final API sunset removal plan.
progress: Scoping and initial PRs created. Python and JS CI matrices updated; Go bench suite added. Dependency analysis spreadsheet attached and preliminary compatibility matrix completed. Identified three high-risk transitive deps: http client layers, proto generation tool, and common telemetry lib.
decision_log: 1) Adopt two-wave compatibility: immediate minimal shims that accept legacy fields, followed by removal window after two SDK releases. 2) Prioritize runtime-critical dep upgrades that reduce per-request allocations (undici, httpx async path, Go net/http tweaks). 3) No breaking changes without migration docs and automated codemods where feasible.
plan_steps: Inventory: finalize transitive dep matrix for python/js/go (done)
Safety tests: expand SDK e2e harness to cover legacy param permutations (in progress)
Parallel PR wave: language-specific bump PRs with microbenchmarks and allocation profiles
Canary: publish pre-release packages, run canary in staging on top-traffic customer routes
Telemetry: enable token-level and route-level failure metrics for first 72h after rollout
Deprecation: announce API sunsetting plan and set removal date (>=60 days notice)
Removal: coordinate removal across docs, console, and server-side router at release window
deps_impacted: javascript: node-fetch -> undici (reduce memcpy + improve keepalive)
go: bump generator tool (protoc-gen-go) and grpc packages to latest minor
protobufs: canonicalize schema package paths to reduce duplicate types
prs: GH: redwood-inference/sdk-python#814 (bump httpx, add async benchmarks)
GH: redwood-inference/sdk-js#662 (replace fetch with undici polyfill, update tests)
GH: redwood-inference/infra-ci#221 (expand matrix nodes for undici/arm64)
checks: Unit: all language clients must pass compatibility permutations (legacy params + new params)
Perf: per-request p95 latency delta must be <= 10% or have documented mitigation
Alloc: python/JS must show reduced median allocations in bench harness (target >=10% decrease)
E2E: smoke tests against staging router and canary customer routes
